name: kanjo
description: 収支統合管理システム — 事業(freee) × 家計(マネーフォワード) を1画面で統合管理する

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kanjo/web build && pnpm --filter @kanjo/api exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/kanjo-worker-build
scripts.test:coverage:account-login: pnpm --filter @kanjo/api run test:coverage:account-login && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run test:coverage:account-login
scripts.test:aux: pnpm run runbooks:test && pnpm run guard-real-data:test && pnpm run github-scripts:test && pnpm run seed-admin:test && pnpm run skills:test && pnpm run delivery:test
scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/sync-project-skills.mjs --check && node scripts/check-glossary.mjs && node scripts/check-report-css.mjs && node scripts/check-graph-lineage.mjs && node scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-design-system-document-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-design-system-delivery.mjs --worktree-content && node scripts/check-design-system-run-references.mjs && pnpm run security:content
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @kanjo/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply kanjo-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @kanjo/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply kanjo-db --remote
scripts.db:checkpoint: pnpm --filter @kanjo/api exec wrangler d1 time-travel info kanjo-db
scripts.design-system:fast: pnpm --filter @kanjo/core exec vitest run test/design-tokens.test.ts && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web exec vitest run src/font-loading-contract.test.ts src/chart-series-contract.test.ts src/common-shell-routes.dom.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 && pnpm run delivery:test && node scripts/check-design-system-document-contract.mjs && pnpm run delivery:check:worktree
scripts.verify:full: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run check:thead && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run check:mobile-layout && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run check:financial-figure && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run check:financial-routes && pnpm --filter @kanjo/web run check:analysis-hub && pnpm run preview:smoke
scripts.evidence:acceptance: pnpm run evidence:capture && pnpm run evidence:check
